name: Stare Miasto (Old Town)
tagline: UNESCO Gothic heart of the city
description: Torun's medieval core is a cobbled maze of red-brick churches, the Old Town Hall and the leaning tower, all overlooking the Wisla. It is the most atmospheric and central place to live, buzzing with cafes and tourists.
bestFor: Nomads who want atmosphere, walkability and cafe culture on the doorstep

name: Bydgoskie Przedmiescie
description: Just west of the centre, this elegant neighbourhood is known for its tree-lined streets, art nouveau villas and townhouses. It offers a quieter, greener setting while staying within easy reach of the old town on foot or by tram.
bestFor: Those wanting character, calm and greenery close to the centre
pros: Short walk to the old town

name: Nowe Miasto (New Town)
tagline: Medieval quarter beside the Old Town
description: Despite its name, the New Town is centuries old and sits right beside the Old Town within the historic core. It has its own market square, churches and a more residential, everyday feel, with good value for a central location.
bestFor: Nomads wanting central living with slightly better value than the Old Town
pros: Better value than the Old Town core
cons: Can be busy near the squares

name: Bielany
description: Home to much of the Nicolaus Copernicus University campus, Bielany is a green, residential area away from the tourist centre. It has a studenty feel, plenty of affordable housing and quick tram links into the historic core.
bestFor: Budget-minded nomads and those wanting a calm, campus-adjacent base
